acceptance_artifact.source:
# Tracer: automatic template definition facts
#
# Before (did not work):
# template<S nonempty_set>:
#     have member S
# \member<R> $in R
# Former behavior: declaration succeeded; membership failed at search_proof (K002).
#
# Now (verified by focused Rust regressions; file gate recorded in journal):
template<S nonempty_set>:
    have member S
\member<R> $in R
forall T nonempty_set:
    \member<T> $in T

template<S set: $is_nonempty_set(S)>:
    have guarded S
\guarded<R> $in R

template<S nonempty_set>:
    have nonempty nonempty_set = S
$is_nonempty_set(\nonempty<R>)
template<n N>:
    have finite finite_set = {n}
$is_finite_set(\finite<2>)
template<S set>:
    have carrier set = S
\carrier<R> = R
template<S nonempty_set, a S>:
    have selected S = a
\selected<R, 2> $in R
\selected<R, 2> = 2

witness exist x R st {x = 2} from 2
template<S set>:
    have existing R:
        existing = 2
\existing<R> = 2
template<S set>:
    obtain obtained from exist x R st {x = 2}
\obtained<R> = 2
prop has_copy(a R):
    exist x R st {x = a}
witness $has_copy(4) from 4
template<S set>:
    obtain atomic from $has_copy(4)
\atomic<R> = 4

prop image_rel(x, y set):
    x = y
forall x {1}, y, z set:
    $image_rel(x, y)
    $image_rel(x, z)
    =>:
        y = z
template<S set>:
    have by replacement_axiom: image from prop image_rel, set {1}
by def $image_rel(1, 1)
1 $in \image<R>
forall y \image<R>:
    exist x {1} st {$image_rel(x, y)}

template<S set>:
    have fn ident(x S) S = x
\ident<R> $in fn(x R) R
\ident<R>(4) = 4
template<T set>:
    have fn flag(x R) N by cases:
        case x = 0: 0
        case x != 0: 1
\flag<R> $in fn(x R) N
\flag<R>(0) = 0
\flag<R>(1) = 1
template<b N>:
    have fn count(n N) N by induc n from 0:
        case n = 0: b
        case n >= 1: count(n - 1) + 1
\count<2> $in fn(n N) N
\count<2>(1 - 1) = 2
\count<2>(1) = \count<2>(1 - 1) + 1 = 3
\count<7>(1 - 1) = 7
\count<7>(1) = \count<7>(1 - 1) + 1 = 8

prop successor_rel(x, y R):
    y = x + 1
claim:
    ? forall x R:
        exist! y R st {$successor_rel(x, y)}
    witness exist! y R st {$successor_rel(x, y)} from x + 1:
        by def $successor_rel(x, x + 1)
template<S set>:
    have fn chosen by exist!:
        ? forall x R:
            exist! y R st {$successor_rel(x, y)}
\chosen<R> $in fn(x R) R
$successor_rel(2, \chosen<R>(2))
forall x, y R:
    $successor_rel(x, y)
    =>:
        y = \chosen<R>(x)
